_comment: Row 759d (O738): listing-filter hrefs (/en/videos/?refinementList[...]) must be refused at admission before ranking. M1 disables the admission arm; M2 keeps the arm but makes the query regex never match. Both leave the score-0 Download div outranked by the 4K filter link, which is the live 2026-09-15 defect the catcher reproduces. Anchors are structural (no value token, no quote, no '=') so the row357 anchor gate classifies them STABLE. Gen 2 (lens flip): M3 deletes the strong-media-signal fail-open (a signed .mp4 with ?sortBy= would be refused); M4 deletes the sort alternative (a resolution-labelled sortBy link would win).
subject: _candidate_admission refuses listing/filter hrefs so the score-0 Download control wins

mutants.label: 759d-M2 the query test is inverted (a filter query reads as not-a-filter)
